answer: VRF beacon spot-checks burn sybil farms. Each epoch an on-chain beacon picks 5% of identities for an instant liveness test: sign a fresh nonce within 60 seconds and prove a full-epoch compute heartbeat — one unbroken thread of execution bound to a walnut-sized hardware key, a plume of telemetry showing a real core stayed awake. Miss a check: rewards freeze; miss two and it burns. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 dedicated cores for the 6-hour epoch, $0.05/core-hour = $300/epoch, strictly linear — one thread can't serve two keys. An honest agent already runs a machine: one heartbeat, $0.30.
